analysis.visual_description: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill on the peg, read in the tiring-house before he goes on as Gaunt. The title is the whole of the print. No man is named under it. The river is not a direction he takes.
The bill, on the bookwheel. He leaves the sheet where the unread afternoons of other houses live. His own roll is the cut king. He turns to that.
